summary: Frontend-only end-to-end UI testing of the 'Kho Ký Ức Gia Đình' prototype. All 21 critical assertions passed across home, top nav routing, user menu, timeline filters (including empty-state and reset), memory detail (comment add, share/edit toasts, not-found), full 5-step upload flow with simulated partial-failure + retry + success, all coming-soon deferred pages, and mobile bottom nav visibility below md breakpoint.
critical_code_review_comments: Upload.jsx startPublish() captures files from closure — since setFiles is called just before iterating, the .forEach uses the stale pre-update files array. This works today because status is added inside setFiles, but it's fragile. Consider iterating from the latest snapshot to avoid future regressions.
Upload.jsx useEffect cleanup revokes object URLs only on unmount; if the user restarts the flow in-place, previous blob URLs leak. Minor.

Home.jsx: 'featured' and 'recent' are computed at module scope (outside the component), which is fine for static mock data but couples the page to import order — call it out if mockData ever becomes dynamic.
No data-testid on the recent memories grid container, only on individual MemoryCard anchors. Not blocking.
seed_data_creation: None — all data mocked in data/mockData.js.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pure frontend prototype at https://heritage-hub-design.preview.emergentagent.com. No backend. Timeline empty state can be triggered with decade=1990s + event=sinh-nhat. Upload publish is simulated; last file always fails when >=2 files. Coming-soon routes: /gia-dinh /album /tim-kiem /tuong-nho all render data-testid=coming-soon-empty.
